title: Banking Analytics Dashboard
summary: A banking analytics dashboard built to monitor deposits, loans, branch performance, and customer segments through a single executive view.
problem: Banking stakeholders needed a unified view of portfolio health, branch efficiency, and customer behavior to support faster financial decision-making.
objectives: Improve visibility into customer and financial KPIs
insights: Tier-1 branches showed 14% higher transaction growth than regional branches.
Delinquency risk is concentrated in medium-ticket loans with reduced repayment velocity.
Cross-sell conversion is strongest in premium customer cohorts.

title: Mobile Sales Analytics Dashboard
summary: A mobile sales analytics dashboard that visualizes revenue trends, brand performance, and city-level sales momentum for business stakeholders.
problem: Sales leaders needed a clear view of product performance, brand share, and regional opportunities without relying on fragmented spreadsheets.
insights: Premium devices drove 63% of margin contribution despite only 34% of unit volume.
Urban markets outperformed with a 22% stronger repeat purchase rate.
Retail partner performance is highly correlated with campaign intensity.
